systems.country_label: projet de digitalisation de la santé en Mauritanie (DIGISANTÉ-MR)
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (direction for promotion of ICT and health education, digital strategy cell), financed by the European Union
systems.tiers: Pilot sites still to be chosen among preselected health centres in five wilayas: Brakna, Trarza, Nouakchott Ouest, Nouakchott Nord, Nouakchott Sud

note: A ministry meeting of 30 April 2026 adopted the criteria for choosing pilot sites for DIGISANTÉ-MR, an EU-financed integrated pilot model of digital transformation in health centres under the Stratégie nationale de santé numérique 2024-2030, with national extension intended; the document does not say what the pilot system does (reporting or patient record), so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
